subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `coverage`, docgate shall compute the requirements-coverage view — for every corpus ID and every live ledger unit, the live designs serving it and the explicit unserved remainder per family — from committed inputs on read and print it (a human table by default, `--json` for the machine face), committing it to no artifact; and `gen-index`/`verify-index` shall carry only the design-plane graph (design liveness and `serves_inverse`), never the coverage join, so that adding or amending a ledger never changes `docs/tech-design/index.*`.
rationale: coverage is a cross-plane join; committing it anywhere couples the planes (issue #70). The universe already lives under `docs/prds/`, so computing on read removes the coupling in both directions and `index.*` regenerates only when designs change
fit_criterion: temp-repo fixtures: `docgate coverage` yields the expected served/unserved partition in both faces; `gen-index` emits no `coverage` key/section and `verify-index` is green over the coverage-free index; **adding a ledger amendment leaves `index.*` byte-identical**; superseding a design still returns its solely-served anchors to unserved in `coverage` output; CI publishes the view as a job summary
